strings.name: Joko Widodo
strings.role: Former president of Indonesia · Former local executive
strings.summary: Jokowi moved from furniture manufacturing to local politics as Solo mayor and Jakarta governor, then Indonesia’s president in 2014–2024. He promoted transport infrastructure, mineral processing and a new capital project, influencing Southeast Asian development. Critics say his later rule strengthened dynastic politics and weakened democratic institutions; he cited elections and free speech in response. Remaining politically active after leaving office, he voiced support for Prabowo’s government in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Rising from local administration to Indonesia’s presidency, he promoted infrastructure, industrial upgrading and a new capital project, influencing Southeast Asian development.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.highlights.h1.title: Infrastructure and industry
strings.highlights.h1.text: Promoted major infrastructure and mineral-processing investment; the new capital remains an ongoing project.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Graduated from the Forestry Faculty, Universitas Gadjah Mada (5 November 1985).
strings.highlights.h2.title: Democracy and dynastic controversy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Critics questioned family politics and institutional independence; he cited elections and free speech in response.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Supports successor’s government
strings.timeline.t1.text: Told reporters he would continue supporting Prabowo’s government as his son Gibran submitted his resignation.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Presidency ends
strings.timeline.t2.text: Left after two terms, succeeded by Prabowo.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Wins reelection
strings.timeline.t3.text: Defeated Prabowo again, later appointing him defence minister.
strings.timeline.t4.title: First presidential victory
strings.timeline.t4.text: Moved from local administration to national leadership, defeating Prabowo.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Jakarta governor
strings.timeline.t5.text: Won alongside Basuki Tjahaja Purnama, entering the capital’s regional government.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Solo mayor
strings.timeline.t6.text: Won with F. X. Hadi Rudyatmo, beginning local executive service.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completes forestry studies
strings.timeline.t7.text: University confirms completion of forestry studies, before work in timber and furniture.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Solo
strings.timeline.t8.text: Raised in a wood trader’s family, later entering business and local politics.
